headline: Chromatin contacts link enhancers and promoters to target genes across genomes
label: Chromatin Contact Target Mapping
summary: Hi-C and Promoter Capture Hi-C contacts are now used to assign regulatory elements to target genes across conditions and tools.
synthesis: The dominant thread here is chromatin contact data used to connect regulatory elements to the genes they control. A Hi-C analysis across three differentiation systems finds that super-enhancers rewire more across conditions and link to identity genes. GOntact applies Promoter Capture Hi-C contacts to infer cis-regulatory element target genes and derive Gene Ontology enrichments in a standalone tool and webserver. A pig pan-genome built from three T2T and sixteen high-quality assemblies is the least related item, addressing centromere evolution, structural variation and genotype-phenotype mapping rather than contact-based regulation. What is new is condition-specific resolution of enhancer-promoter wiring paired with functional annotation of inferred targets.
